intro: Stay cool and supported as you work or study with Poise. Its breathable net back, tilt mechanism, and lumbar support keep you comfortable, while the sleek black design blends into any modern setup.

features.title: Net back that keeps you cool
features.text: Premium net backrest allows airflow, so you stay comfortable even through long hours of study, work, or online meetings.

features.title: Ergonomic lumbar support
features.text: Lower back support follows your spine’s curve, easing strain and helping you maintain healthy posture through extended sitting.

features.title: Contact-tilt for flexible comfort
features.text: The permanent contact-tilt mechanism moves with you, providing steady support and flexibility as you lean or shift positions.

features.title: Upright lock for focus
features.text: Lock the chair in an upright position whenever you need to stay centered, steady, and focused on important tasks.

features.title: Loop armrests for relaxed shoulders
features.text: Fixed armrests give your arms a natural resting place, reducing shoulder tension while typing, writing, or reading.

features.title: Sturdy build with neat design
features.text: PP seat and back cover keep the chair tidy, while the 5-pronged metal pedestal ensures strong and stable daily use.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
